thread:
tariq: Heads-up: onboarding hit two weird CLI issues today while pairing with a new hire. macOS 12.6, installed `redwoodctl` via Homebrew, then tried `redwoodctl serve --local` for the sample but it failed with: "cannot connect to docker socket: permission denied".

emily: Do they have Docker Desktop running as their user? On mac it's usually /var/run/docker.sock but perms can get funky with brew-installed tools. What does `ls -l /var/run/docker.sock` show?

tariq: socket is owned by root:wheel and mode is srw-rw----. User is in the staff group only. We added them to the docker group (created group), restarted Docker, but still getting socket perms denied.

sylvie: On mac Docker Desktop manages the socket. Creating a docker group is linux-y and won't help. Restart Docker Desktop and reboot the user session. Also check if `DOCKER_HOST` env var is set incorrectly (we've seen old labs export tcp://127.0.0.1:2375 which breaks the ctl local flow).

tariq: Rebooted, cleared DOCKER_HOST. Local serve got past docker socket, but then `redwoodctl init` tried to write shell completion into `/usr/local/etc/bash_completion.d/` and failed: "permission denied" when brew keg owned by root. The install guide suggests `redwoodctl completion install`, but that needs sudo which is annoying for new hires.

emily: We should document `redwoodctl completion write --stdout >> ~/.bash_completion` as a non-sudo alternative. Also offer a note for zsh: `redwoodctl completion zsh > ~/.oh-my-zsh/completions/_redwoodctl`.

tariq: Good idea. After that, we hit auth trouble: `redwoodctl login` opened the device-code URL but behind corp HTTP proxy the CLI couldn't poll the token endpoint: `net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded)`. The browser flow completed but CLI timed out.

sylvie: Proxy is the culprit. We needed to export `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` plus `NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1`. The older ctl didn't respect proxy envs for the polling request — fixed in 0.13.0. What version did you have?

tariq: 0.12.6 via brew. Upgraded to 0.13.0 binary, set envs, and ran `redwoodctl login --timeout 120s` and it worked. Worth noting: our support doc should include proxy env tips and `NO_PROXY` for local callbacks.

emily: I'll PR a docs patch with two steps: non-sudo completion install, and proxy troubleshooting (HTTP_PROXY/NO_PROXY examples). Also add a note that Homebrew installs might require `brew doctor` fixups for completion dirs.

ops-bot: Created internal ticket #2034 for CLI onboarding improvements: "docs: completions & docker/socket & proxy troubleshooting" assigned to @emily.

devex-bot: Thanks for the repro, @tariq — will add a short checklist to the new-hire quickstart. :white_check_mark:
